subject: Re: Redwood POC — access, success criteria, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood POC — access, success criteria, and next steps
Attachments: Acme_POC_MAP_20261102.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery + proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the POC: 

Success criteria (we agreed):
- End-to-end response time <= 200ms median for customer-facing generation flows
- Embedding quality parity with your existing vendor on retrieval use cases (precision@10 >= 0.65 on sample dataset)
- Cost per 1k requests within the target budget you shared (approx $X)

POC scope & plan:
- 2-week sandbox POC focused on search relevancy + chat response latency
- Redwood to provide sandbox API key(s) + optional SSO invite for your test org
- Acme to run evaluation suite (sample prompts + metrics) and share results at end of week 2

Access & security items we need to start: 
1) Preferred onboarding method: sandbox API key (fastest) or SSO (SAML) — confirm which you prefer to start with
2) IP allowlist ranges (if you want us to restrict key usage)
3) Contact for SSO admin (if SSO) or email where we should send the scoped key

Tentative timeline:
- Confirm access by EOD Wednesday (Nov 4)
- POC start: week of Nov 9
- Check-in: end of week 1 (Nov 16) and final review after week 2 (Nov 23)

Next steps (action owners):
- Alex: confirm who owns SSO/IT and whether you want API key or SSO to start (by Nov 4)
- Priya (IT): provide IP ranges and SAML metadata if you prefer SSO
- Redwood (Marissa/Neha): provision sandbox key / send SSO invite and send MAP (attached)

Attached: Acme_POC_MAP_20261102.pdf — includes evaluation plan, metrics, and success criteria.

If that all looks right, reply with preferred access method and we'll provision the key or send the invite immediately.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0178

Thanks Marissa — good summary and aligned on the success criteria. A few notes from our side: 

- I will own procurement/contracting for the POC and will coordinate internally.
- We prefer to start with a sandbox API key so our engineering team can iterate quickly. We can switch to SSO once we've validated functionality.
- Priya (cc'd) is our IT lead and will handle IP allowlist / SSO setup. Priya, can you confirm the ranges below and provide the best contact to receive SSO invites?

IP ranges we can whitelist from our side for outbound requests to your endpoints (please let us know if you require other ranges):
- 34.210.0.0/16
- 52.23.0.0/16

Also: can you share your SOC2 report/certification or a link to it for our security review?

I'll aim to confirm internal calendar availability tomorrow so we can lock Nov 9 as the POC start date.

Best,
Alex Jenkins
Product Lead, Search & Recommendations | Acme Corp
alex.jenkins@acme.com

Hi Alex —

Happy to get you started with a scoped sandbox API key. We can provision a key limited to the POC project and tag it to Acme; keys are valid for 30 days by default.

Proposed sandbox key (provisioned once you confirm the recipient email):
- Key: sk-sandbox-acme-01-XXXX (this is a placeholder; we will post the actual key in a secure channel after you confirm the recipient email)

Quick notes / next steps to get started:
1) If you want us to restrict usage by IP, confirm the CIDRs you will use (34.210.0.0/16 and 52.23.0.0/16 as Alex suggested).
2) If you prefer SSO, send the SAML metadata URL or the admin email to invite (we can also do SCIM provisioning for user sync).
3) For security review: SOC2 report available here: https://redwoodinference.com/security/soc2-report.pdf

Sample curl (sandbox):
curl https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-sandbox-acme-01-XXXX" 
  -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":64}'

I've attached a short sandbox-api-instructions.txt with examples and the MAP reference. Once you confirm the recipient email for the key (or the SSO admin email), I'll provision and send the credentials via an encrypted channel.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
